content:
The official Amazon Black Friday sale has now transitioned to the official Cyber Monday Weekend event, and the Apple deals are still soaring. Alongside AirPods Pro 3 at the fantastic $100 off and AirPods Max at $130 off, we also still have the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup at $100 off, the just-released OLED iPad mini (A20 Pro) at $100 off, and the latest 2026 AirTag 2 at the $18 all-time low

The Mac deals though…the Mac deals are crazy: M5 MacBook Air at $400 off, all of the most affordable MacBook Neo configs are back at $599 ($100 off), and we have even lower prices on the brand new M6 MacBook Pro at $250 off. Everything awaits below.
